ownership_summary: Owned by Monumental Sports & Entertainment (MSE), led by founder, chairman, managing partner and CEO Ted Leonsis, majority owner of the Wizards since 2010. Qatar Investment Authority bought roughly 5% of MSE in 2023 at a $4.05bn valuation and increased its stake in December 2025, when Arctos Partners also joined as a minority investor, buying out Laurene Powell Jobs.
revenue_evidence: Revenue and operating income are for 2024-25 season and net of revenue sharing and arena debt service.
